name: Prologue
desc: You wake up in the scrapyard. Grandpa is tinkering with a broken generator nearby. Another day in the Scrapyard District.

name: Getting Organized
desc: Grandpa nods approvingly at your new sorting station. 'Your father used to keep things organized too,' he says, looking away.

name: The Workshop Awakens
desc: As the workshop powers up for the first time in years, you notice scratches on the workbench — measurements, notes, a name: your father's.

name: Father's Legacy
desc: Behind the rusted door, covered in dust and cobwebs, stands a mecha. Small, old, battered — but unmistakably your father's first build. The cockpit still has his callsign etched into the frame.

name: Turning Junk Into Future
desc: The refinery hums to life. Grandpa watches from the doorway. 'He always said this machine would change everything,' he whispers. 'He wasn't wrong.'

name: First Schematic
desc: You study the Nano Infra schematics. The engineering is elegant — far beyond what you'd expect from street tech. Where did these come from?

name: The Bazaar
desc: The Neon Bazaar is everything they warned you about — and more. Holographic vendors, whispered deals, and the unmistakable scent of opportunity.

name: The Scrap Thief
speaker: grandpa
desc: A kid from the slums is caught stealing polymer scrap from the yard. Grandpa looks at you — your call.

choices.label: Let the kid go with a warning
choices.desc: Everyone's desperate. You know that better than most.
choices.log: You let the kid go. Grandpa nods slowly.

choices.label: Offer the kid a job sorting scrap
choices.desc: If they're going to take it anyway, might as well make it official.
choices.log: The kid starts tomorrow. You've got your first employee.

choices.label: Report them to the district patrol
choices.desc: Law is law. Even out here.
choices.log: The patrol takes the kid. You get a nod from the officer.

choices.label: Take what THEY have and send them running
choices.desc: Steal from me? Let's see how that feels.
choices.log: The kid runs. You're richer. Grandpa says nothing.

name: Downed Pilot
speaker: narrator
desc: After a patrol, you find a rival pilot pinned under wreckage. Their mecha is totaled but the parts are salvageable. They're conscious and in pain.

choices.label: Free them and call for help
choices.desc: You wouldn't want to be left there either.

choices.label: Free them, then ask if you can have the parts
choices.desc: Help them, but don't waste the opportunity.
choices.log: Fair trade. They keep their life, you keep the scraps.

choices.label: Strip the mecha parts first, then call for help
choices.desc: They'll live. But those servos won't wait.
choices.log: By the time help arrives, the frame is a skeleton. The pilot watches.

name: Corporate Interest
speaker: narrator
desc: A suit from Taeyang Forge visits the scrapyard. They want to buy exclusive salvage rights to the industrial zone. The offer is generous. Too generous.

choices.label: Refuse the deal
choices.desc: Your father investigated these people. You don't take their money.
choices.log: The suit leaves. Grandpa exhales. 'Good call, kid.'

choices.label: Counter-offer: non-exclusive, double the price
choices.desc: If they want access, they pay YOUR rate.
choices.log: They agree. Easy money. Grandpa looks uncomfortable.

choices.label: Take the deal
choices.desc: Money is money. The scrapyard needs it.
choices.log: Cash in hand. But Taeyang trucks now roll through YOUR yard.

name: Something in the Pile
desc: While sorting a deep pile of electronic scrap, you find something unusual — a humanoid frame, half-buried in circuit boards. It's small. Industrial design. Old but functional.

choices.label: Bring it to the workshop and power it up
choices.desc: It's in rough shape, but the workshop has what you need.
choices.log: It boots. One eye flickers. 'TASK... ASSIGN... TASK...'

choices.label: Study it first, then repair carefully
choices.desc: Rushing repairs on unknown tech is how people lose fingers.
choices.log: 'Kinetic Industrial Task Automaton, designation K.I.T.A. Ready for assignment.'

choices.label: Strip it for components
choices.desc: An intact android frame is worth more as parts than as a helper.
choices.log: The android is dismantled. Grandpa watches in silence.
